notes.title: Introducing Floorball Practice
notes.notes:
[p][i]This is a re-upload from November 30, 2024[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Steam’s First Floorball Video Game! [/b][/h3][p]Just in time for the Men's World Floorball Championships 2024 (WFC), we are thrilled to announce Steam’s very first floorball video game – Floorball Practice! This marks only the second floorball video game ever, following Floorball League, which was released back in 2010. Our game offers a fresh and interactive take, focusing on practicing and improving the character's floorball skills.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324094/7384712e01af53a86c3b199b8e3245b3950fa327.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]About FIJOY Games AS[/b][/h3][p]Hi there! My name is Filip, I’m a 26-year-old from Norway, and I’ve been passionate about floorball for almost 14 years. I played for 10 years before taking a break, then made a comeback to enjoy another four years on the court. Alongside floorball, I’ve always been a gamer with a love for open-world games—especially those that let you upgrade, purchase, and customize gear, clothing, and more. That’s exactly the kind of engaging experience I’m bringing to Floorball Practice.

Our studio, FIJOY Games AS, has acquired all the necessary resources and development kits to publish games on PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo platforms, in addition to Steam. While Floorball Practice is launching on Steam in Early Access, our goal is to bring the game to consoles after the full release is ready.

[/p][h3][b]What’s in Store for You?[/b][/h3][p]Enough about us—let’s dive into the details of Floorball Practice!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324094/90be543aa496811fb6917ffeb47b0f3cfc7a4513.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Floorball Practice[/b][/h3][p]Step into the immersive world of [b]Floorball Practice[/b], the ultimate training ground for Floorball enthusiasts! Built on the cutting-edge [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b], this game pushes the boundaries of realism with [b]ray tracing[/b], [b]lumen lighting[/b], and [b]detailed characters[/b]. Designed to fine-tune your Floorball skills, this Early Access title offers an open-world experience like no other—laying the foundation for the next phase in Floorball gaming.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324094/b0959b10f3c1a98e3bced304b73555891e153b49.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Key Features[/b][/h2][h3][b]Explore an Open World[/b][/h3][p]Travel through a sprawling open world featuring multiple Floorball halls connected by a train system. Venture into lush [b]forests to jog or run[/b], boosting your stamina while taking in stunning visuals across a dynamic [b]weather system[/b] with a fully functioning [b]day and night cycle[/b].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324094/477fdbe952db813ebd28e022388ac83049ca8ec5.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Master Your Skills[/b][/h3][list][*][p] Practice like a pro with [b]objectives and skill-based activities[/b] designed to refine your Floorball techniques.
[/p][/*][*][p] Practice shooting with customizable [b]sticks, balls, rinks, goals, and Floorball fields[/b]—designed with gear you can unlock and arrange to your liking.
[/p][/*][*][p] Unlock advanced [b]animations[/b] and [b]shooting finishes[/b] to perfect your style.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324094/08227592be4c15f8ef0d6aeca0c57c9141761792.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Customize Your Experience[/b][/h3][list][*][p] Choose between [b]male or female characters[/b], with options for [b]left- or right-handed playstyles[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p] Build your identity with a wide range of [b]clothing, sticks, and training gear[/b] available through an in-game currency system.
[/p][/*][*][p] Use the in-game [b]phone system[/b] to order gear, set GPS destinations, manage playlists, and more.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324094/8ccd769ec8ca0edc762d7c774f446e7a650c3e90.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324094/9f51646f67357044b423fa9f0af35420335695ed.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Practice Alone or with a Friend[/b][/h3][p]Switch seamlessly between [b]first-person[/b] and [b]third-person[/b] perspectives to fully immerse yourself in the action. Play solo, or share the Floorball journey with a friend or sibling in [b]local split-screen[/b] multiplayer mode.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324094/92c10ea1967c5b8f484604676668d0e736089b19.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Dynamic Gameplay Systems[/b][/h3][list][*][p] Stay energized with a [b]drinking and eating system[/b] that adds a layer of realism to your training routine.
[/p][/*][*][p] Experience [b]licensed music tracks[/b] to create the perfect soundtrack for your practice sessions.
[/p][/*][*][p] Level up your character as you progress, unlocking new abilities and expanding your potential on the field.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324094/c05d3b401a73dc5309c42bb38be4949ab4e37c15.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Future of Floorball Gaming[/b][/h3][p][b]Floorball Practice[/b] is just the beginning. This title serves as a stepping stone to [b]Floorball Divisions[/b], which will include full-sized matches, league systems, and much more. Get a head start on mastering your skills before competing on the grand stage when it launches in Early Access in 2028.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324094/7b1ea216c43d502f3a57956d3305984cc6fc3c83.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Prepare to practice, explore, and rise to greatness in Floorball Practice—arriving in Early Access in December 2025.[/b][/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324094/90df48d6b237f427f4e85c1f667660791aa7eec3.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Add to Wishlist[/b][/h3][p]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375350/Floorball_Practice[/p]
